messages.author: 13d0e40ead8b0219
messages.subject: Diversity out red covariates
parts:
Karl,

I'm interested in your thoughts about using the generation of DO mice as an additive covariate. Does this make sense, or is generation accounted for somehow in calculating the allele probabilities?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Diversity out red covariates
parts:
generation is taken into account when calculating allele probabilities,
but you probably also want to include indicators for generation as
covariates in the QTL analysis, since there are likely important batch
effects, and you'd be obtaining different generations at 3 month or so
intervals.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Diversity out red covariates
parts:
Yes, you need to use 0/1 indicators, with one fewer covariate than you
have distinct generations.
Something like this:

   generation <- factor(generation)
   X <- model.matrix(~ generation)[,-1]

karl
